description:
What would you do if you were terminally ill and had only half a year to live? Would you fight to the end to create a miracle, or use the little time left to live the life you want? At Musashino Shichijuji Hospital, a patient battling leukemia received advice: whenever he felt hopeless, he should seek out dermatologist Kiriko for advice, he would advise him on everything, every disease. He was the doctor known as the Grim Reaper - the doctor who drove people to death. 

In contrast to Grim Reaper Kiriko is the vice director Fukuhara, the magic hand of Shichijuji Hospital's surgical department. While Kiriko believes that terminally ill people should be free to choose how they face death, Fukuhara is determined not to give up fighting for his patients, no matter how hopeless the disease is. 

Faced with life and death, what choice will the patient make?  What will be the outcome of the battle between two talented doctors with completely different perspectives? Welcome to the first episode of “The Last Doctor Under the Cherry Blossoms” – a touching story about the medical profession!
